candidates.title: Image2Sim: Scaling Embodied Navigation via Generative Neural Simulator
candidates.why_candidate: Converts captured RGB-D imagery into interactive neural simulators and more than 10M action/instruction samples.

candidates.title: Mask2Real-WM: Segmentation Masks as a Sim-to-Real Bridge for Controllable Dexterous World Models
candidates.why_candidate: Strong action-conditioned dexterous world model with inspectable interactive and long-horizon demos.

candidates.title: Lift3D-VLA: Lifting VLA Models to 3D Geometry and Dynamics-Aware Manipulation
candidates.why_candidate: Explicit 3D geometry and future-dynamics modeling with broad simulation and real-robot evaluation.

candidates.title: Native Video-Action Pretraining for Generalizable Robot Control
candidates.why_candidate: LingBot-VA 2.0 is a native causal video-action foundation model with official release evidence.

candidates.title: VLAFlow: A Unified Training Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models via Co-training and Future Latent Alignment
candidates.why_candidate: Controlled study of VLA pretraining objectives with future latent alignment.

candidates.title: KAM-WM: Kinematic Affordance Maps from Latent World Models for Robot Manipulation
candidates.why_candidate: Uses a single latent velocity query as a task-conditioned manipulation cue.

candidates.title: From Fixed to Free Cameras: Calibration-Free View-Robust Vision-Language-Action Model
candidates.why_candidate: Camera-centric action factorization targets practical deployment robustness.

triage.reason: Strong controllable world-model evidence and direct project fit.
